body_text:
Today I went back to a place I frequented as a 15-year-old... 🏀

I still remember coming to Newton after school — playing basketball nearby, grabbing bak chor mee at the hawker centre, just hanging out with friends.

It felt like our little corner of the city. 🍜

But a lot has changed over the last few decades.

What was once a quiet residential enclave quietly became one of Singapore's most established health hubs — anchored by hospitals, medical centres, and specialist clinics.

Property prices in the area have stayed remarkably resilient because of it.

That's not a coincidence. That's planning. 🏥

And Newton is just one example.

Across Singapore in 2026, the URA has lined up some of the most significant transformation plans in years — new regional hubs, infrastructure upgrades, rezoning, and thousands of new homes.

Each one a potential price catalyst.

Each one hides opportunities for those who know how to read it. 📊

Why do I know so much about URA Transformation plans, you might ask? 🤔

Because 13 years ago, I had to make my own first property investment — and I refused to rely on luck.

I went deep into Singapore's master plans, studied the data, and developed a framework called Urban Transformation.

That framework led me to a property later featured in the Straits Times as a top performer from 2014–2019. 20–30% gains in 4 years. 📈

Since then, I've helped hundreds of investors do the same. 🏆

Now I'm sharing everything in a FREE Masterclass — so you can identify which 2026 URA transformation plans to act on, and how to pick the right property before the market catches on. 🎓

👉 Sign up now to secure your seat.
